campaign.surfaceSet: R9-R04 frozen split integration: all 16 source-audit feature definitions, linked requirement parent cases and PDP0-501 crosswalk traces; two packet capability repairs retained and checked for predecessor immutability.

verifiedFacts.detail: R9-R04 freeze, bundle, rebuild verification, repair map, reused R9-R02 operation ledger/schema/projection, all seven source preimages, and all four selected postimages match their recorded SHA-256 pins. The predecessor R9-R03 actual H file hashes to 34e20d2c…f55976 as frozen and bundled.

All 16 requested audit IDs resolve to their exact capability IDs and owner surfaces. The candidate contains 487 capabilities and 38 requirements; the feature subset has 52 leaf cases and 54 linked requirement-parent cases. The 501-row crosswalk has 501 unique IDs, exact expected original/third-pass populations, no duplicates/missing/unexpected IDs, and all 16 reviewed rows remain BOUND_EXISTING. The freeze preserves 54 identities, 216 phase cells and 462 historical owner rows; retained projection has 248 operations.

All 34 parent cases across AUD-CAP-028, AUD-CLONE-004, AUD-CLONE-006, AUD-CLONE-017, AUD-COLOR-007, AUD-DELIV-007 and AUD-COLOR-001 now exactly match linked leaf polarity, given, when and then. SourceCapabilityCaseId links resolve and requirement membership is retained.

Missing, stale or ambiguous provider/license/rights/policy evidence maps to UNKNOWN_OUTCOME only. REJECTED conditions are limited to an explicitly invalid, unsupported or denied request. Leaf and parent negative then fields are byte-equal. However, the positive observableContract.resultVariants still includes UNKNOWN, which conflicts with the negative contract’s UNKNOWN_OUTCOME token; see F-08.

R04 pins the R03 freeze, bundle and actual H record. R03 freeze/bundle/H plus the R02 freeze/bundle/H, operation ledger/schema and retained projection all match their pinned local hashes. R04 capability changes versus R03 are limited to the GEN-024 negative then; requirement changes are limited to the 34 F-06 parent when fields and linked GEN-024 negative then. The 501-row crosswalk is byte-identical to R03.
R04 freeze and rebuild evidence both record canonicalApply NONE and phaseStatusEffect NONE. This review wrote only its separate observation record and did not modify source or phase status.

Live PDP-0 remains IN_PROGRESS with 9 stale and 21 missing source pins of 188, and 0 outstandingMeaningIds. Owner decision, root adoption, schema registration and apply authorization remain unset. Currentness was observed, not refreshed or mutated.

findings.location: R04 capabilities postimage: MEDIA-P0-COHORT02-AUD-GEN-024-LEAF-POS then, observableContract.resultVariants; linked MEDIA-P0-COHORT02-AUD-GEN-024-MEDIA-REQ-CAP-CAPABILITY-POS parent then has the same value.
findings.finding: The positive observable contract lists UNKNOWN as a possible result variant, while the adverse contract defines UNKNOWN_OUTCOME as the result for missing, stale or ambiguous required evidence. These are competing names for the same uncertainty class in one capability response contract. F-07 adverse routing itself is repaired and literal leaf/parent parity passes; the remaining mismatch is the positive result-variant enum.
findings.repair: Replace UNKNOWN with UNKNOWN_OUTCOME in the positive observableContract.resultVariants, or define and structurally distinguish UNKNOWN if it is intentionally a different state. Keep missing/stale/ambiguous evidence mapped only to UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and preserve exact positive leaf/parent parity.
findings.predecessor: R9-R04 frozen integrated candidate; F-07 was raised against R9-R03 and is otherwise repaired in this candidate.
findings.acceptanceCriterion: The capability contract uses one unambiguous token for the missing/stale/ambiguous evidence outcome across success observable-contract enums and adverse cases; positive and negative leaf/parent fields remain exactly equal and REJECTED remains limited to explicit invalid, unsupported or denied requests.
findings.nextLegalAction: Repair only the GEN-024 positive observableContract.resultVariants enum in the candidate leaf and linked parent, then submit a new frozen cut for independent review. Do not apply canonically or advance phase.
